title: Smart Sign Language Glove
subtitle: Real-Time Sign Translation with Flex Sensors, Random Forest ML & React
description: An assistive communication wearable translating sign language gestures into text in real time. An ESP32 measures finger articulation via 5 flex sensors and wrist posture via an MPU6050 IMU, streaming telemetry to a Python Random Forest classifier and a real-time React web interface via WebSockets.
